content.bridge_context: Learning how to collect, organize, and understand information (data).

units.title: Mean, Median, and Mode
units.explanation: Mean is average. Median is the middle value. Mode is the most frequent value.
units.dual_language_instruction: Find the mode of 2, 3, 2, 5, 2. / 2, 3, 2, 5, 2 का बहुलक (mode) ज्ञात कीजिए।

units.title: Range
units.explanation: The difference between the highest and lowest values in a data set.
units.dual_language_instruction: Calculate range: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50. / परास (range) की गणना करें: 10, 20, 30, 40, 50।
